rounds.title: ROUND 1 · EMERGENCY INBOX
rounds.rule: Enough points = URGENT. Miss no real emergencies, and allow at most 1 false alarm.
rounds.fa: A real emergency was missed. Lower FLAG AT SCORE.
rounds.fb: Too many false alarms. Raise FLAG AT SCORE a little.

rounds.title: ROUND 2 · SPAM FOLDER
rounds.rule: Enough points = BLOCKED. Block no real mail, and let at most 1 spam through.
rounds.fa: Too much spam got through. Lower FLAG AT SCORE.
rounds.fb: Real mail got blocked. Raise FLAG AT SCORE or lower ALL-CAPS POINTS.
